policy: Revelation 7:4-8 names the ancestral persons in its tribal enumeration, on the owners scoped reading. Preserve independent people and territorial records and readings outside this passage.
source: Essenthos, the owners Revelation 7 ancestral-name reading of 2026-10-04

rulings.why: The owner reads Israel in this enumeration of tribes as their ancestor Jacob, who bears the name Israel. This ruling is scoped to Revelation 7:4 and does not replace national readings elsewhere.
